messages:
emily: Customer (acme-corp) says promo 'WELCOME2026' is rejected as "invalid" during checkout. Dashboard shows it active with 1,000 available. Customer email: j.smith@acme.com. Request ID: req_01Fabc123. Can someone triage?

tom: Thanks — can you paste the API payload + exact response (no PII) and timestamp? Also which region/plan?

emily: Payload (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/promos/redeem
{
  "code": "WELCOME2026",
  "user_email": "j.smith+acme@redwood-mail.com",
  "client_time": "2026-02-28T21:12:03Z"
}
```
API returned 400 with body: `{"error":"invalid_promo_code","code":"PROMO_INVALID"}`. Happened at 2026-02-28T21:12:05Z. Customer tried both web checkout and mobile.

sam: Quick checks I ran: looked up code in promos table:
```
SELECT id, code, active, expires_at, redemptions_remaining FROM promos WHERE code='WELCOME2026';
-- -> id=842, active=true, expires_at='2026-12-31', redemptions_remaining=0
```
Dashboard cache (redis/secondary) still shows 1000 available — looks like a backfill/aggregation lag.

tom: redemptions_remaining=0 explains API response (we return PROMO_INVALID when none left). Why does the DB show 0 though? Any recent backfill or data migration for partner promos?

sam: Yes, we ran a backfill last week to populate redemptions for legacy campaigns. I can see a job that ran which deduped by email but didn't normalize plus-addressing. There are 3 redemption rows for WELCOME2026 across alias emails -> net counted as 3 even though dashboard aggregates differently. Also an org-merge cleanup reduced the remaining count incorrectly for multi-account customers.

emily: The customer insists they never redeemed it. Can we confirm there are redemptions tied to other accounts (maybe same person with alt email)?

sam: Query for redemption records for that promo code:
```
SELECT user_email, created_at, source FROM promo_redemptions WHERE promo_id=842 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
-- -> j.smith+old@acme.com 2026-02-27 (web)
-- -> j.smith+trial@acme.com 2025-11-03 (manual_grant)
-- -> partner-internal@acme.com 2025-10-01 (partner-import)
```
So 3 redemptions exist against what looks like the same person via plus-addressing and an import. The UI reads from cached aggregated counts which are stale; the authoritative counter was decremented by the backfill job and now shows 0 available.

tom: Action items: 1) For the customer we should either issue a manual credit or reissue a unique one-off code. 2) Fix the backfill dedupe logic for plus-addresses and org-merge cases. 3) In the short term make the API error message clearer (PROMO_SOLD_OUT vs PROMO_INVALID) so customers get actionable feedback.

emily: I already offered a manual 50-credit grant to the customer and they're ok with that for now. Can billing apply a credit and note case?

sam: Applied manual grant of 50 credits to acme-corp (internal tx id: tx_9b3). Left audit entry. Also filed a bug: EX-4521 "promo backfill dedupe counts plus-addresses incorrectly after import/merge". Assigned to me, priority P1 for data correctness.

tom: I'll update the API error mapping to return PROMO_SOLD_OUT when redemptions_remaining <= 0 — filed PR draft and unit tests. Also adding a quick dashboard cache invalidation hook to run after backfill jobs.

emily: Thanks. Customer notified and confirmed credit applied. Closing but leaving bug open until backfill fix. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident created EX-4521, linked to support ticket #SUP-8842.

emily: If anyone needs the raw logs/req ids I can paste them to the private incident thread. Thanks all. :pray:
